# T-1: Add update routing

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Add `senti plugin update [name]` routing for bulk and single-plugin update while preserving the existing plugin operation output style.

## Acceptance Criteria
- `update` without args reaches the non-mutating bulk candidate planning flow for the bounded enabled-package set.
- `update <name>` reaches a single installed-plugin update flow.
- `update <name>` does not print the bulk confirmation prompt.

## Implementation Notes
Keep routing in `src/plugin.js`. Add or reuse registry helpers in `src/lib/plugin-registry.js` so single update operates only on installed packages and bulk update can build a non-mutating plan for enabled installed packages within the existing `MAX_ENABLED_PLUGIN_PACKAGES` bound.

## Test Strategy
Spec-local CLI tests cover command routing with and without a name.
